Declare the model or training workflow output.

Acts as an identity marker: place it after the optimizer as the terminal training node, or between the final model tensor and a loss when an explicit prediction relay is useful. It does not add a layer. The class count validates classification output width; the preceding model layer still owns the actual projection.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Training](../categories/training.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | output, final, predictions, classes |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Final model tensor or terminal optimizer state. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Predictions** | Tensor | No | 1 | Optional identity relay for the final model tensor. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Output | Classes | `num_classes` | Integer | `10` | `1-1048576` | The run | Expected classification output width. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a training control |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Training Role | training control | Yes | compiled as a terminal training-graph marker without adding a module |
| Compile | supported | Yes | As above |
| Training | supported | Yes | As above |
| Implementation Owner | training backend | Yes | As above |
| Support State | real | Yes | As above |
| Workflow Lane | training control | Yes | Category-derived fallback used only when no narrower runtime workflow lane is declared. |

## Usage

```text
Every valid graph must have at least one Output node.
```

## Tips

- Connect model output AND loss output.
- Multiple outputs are supported.
